description:
# Crowd Free Sail Boston Fireworks Display
Boston knows how to celebrate in grand style — and Sail 250 brings that spirit to an entirely new level. Join us aboard Northern Lights for a special 2-hour Sail Boston Fireworks Cruise, offering a crowd-free alternative to the busy shoreline. Enjoy the festive atmosphere on the harbor as the tall ships gather, wave to spectators along the waterfront, and take in the stunning views of Boston Harbor during this once-in-a-generation maritime celebration.

Avoid the masses and enjoy front-row views of the Sail 250 fireworks from the comfort of Northern Lights. This classic 1920s-style commuter yacht features a climate-controlled main cabin, an open-air top deck, and four restrooms onboard. Our fully stocked bar and appetizer selections will be available for purchase throughout the cruise.

Northern Lights will operate rain or shine; however, the Sail 250 fireworks are weather permitting.

# Notable Highlights

- Enjoy panoramic views of the Boston skyline and iconic waterfront landmarks as we cruise the harbor.
- Take in the vibrant Seaport District with its colorful nighttime lighting.
- Experience an unforgettable fireworks display over Boston Harbor, with unmatched visibility from the water.

##About Northern Lights  
A Coast Guard Certified Captains and extremely friendly and knowledgeable crew who are trained to help in the event of an emergency operate Northern Lights. The motor yacht Northern Lights is stylized after the classic New England 1920s style steamships. She is one of the most comfortable and versatile cruise vessels in Boston Harbor. Northern Lights is 115-feet in length, features six bathrooms, and provides ample seating throughout the ship for up to 149 passengers. She is built for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures. Thus, she is excellent for taking out groups of friends and family to see the harbor. Sit back and relax in our climate-controlled (heating and air conditioning) cabin or enjoy the sea breeze on our open top deck. Be sure to visit our fully stocked bar on the main deck to purchase refreshments.
